001: Hello, I would like to get a certificate of registration at my place of residence.
Hello, for that you need your passport and an application. Did you fill out the form on the website?
No, I didn't know you could fill it out online.
No problem, I'll give you a form. Please fill it out.
Okay, and how long will it take?
Usually the certificate is ready within three business days.
002: Dmitry, I lost my passport, and I need to get it replaced urgently.
You need to go to the migration department and file a report about the loss.
And what documents do I need to bring with me?
Bring your birth certificate and two photos. And, of course, the application.
I see, and will it take a lot of time?
If all the documents are in order, the procedure usually takes about two weeks.
003: Hello, I would like to extend my registration at my place of stay.
Hello, for that you need a lease agreement and a statement from the property owner.
I have the agreement, but the owner is on vacation right now.
Then we need his notarized power of attorney for submitting documents.
I see, and what if I bring it tomorrow?
Yes, of course, bring it tomorrow, we'll see you without waiting in line.
004: Could you tell me, please, which window I can get an international passport at?
International passports are processed at windows numbered five through eight.
And did I need to book an appointment in advance through the portal?
Yes, it's recommended, but if there's an available slot, we can see you today.
Great, and what documents are needed for the application?
Your passport, your old international passport if you have one, and a completed application form.
005: Hello, I want to submit documents to get a residence permit.
Hello, for that you need a package of documents, including health insurance.
I've prepared all the documents, except for the income statement.
You can get the income statement from the tax office, it will take a few days.
And can I bring it in later?
Yes, you can bring it in within a month, that's acceptable.
006: Sergey, do you know how to get an extract from the Unified State Register of Real Estate?
You can order it online through the government services portal or at this center.
And if I order it online, how long do I wait?
Usually the extract arrives within one business day.
That's convenient. And at the center, would it take longer?
Yes, at the center you usually need to wait about three days.
007: Hello, I would like to register a marriage next month.
Hello, for that you need to submit a joint application a month before the date.
And can we choose a specific date and time?
Yes, you can choose a date if it's still available in the schedule.
Great, and what documents are needed for the application?
Passports of both of you, and if either of you was married before, then the divorce certificate.
008: Hello, I would like to get a duplicate of my birth certificate.
Hello, for that you need to write an application and pay the state fee.
And can I order the duplicate online?
Yes, you can submit the application online, but you'll need to pick up the document in person.
I see, and how long will it take?
Usually making the duplicate takes about five business days.
009: Excuse me, can I get a social card for public transport?
Yes, if you qualify for benefits, you can get it at this window.
I have a veteran of labor certificate, will that work?
Yes, that works. Fill out the application and attach a copy of the certificate.
Thank you, and will the card be ready right away?
No, the card will be ready in ten days, we'll notify you by phone.
010: Hello, I would like to get a consultation on a tax deduction for education expenses.
Hello, for that you need to provide the contract with the educational institution and payment receipts.
And can I submit the documents for the deduction through my employer?
Yes, you can, but for that you need to get a notice from the tax office.
I see, and if I file the tax return myself, when will I get the money back?
Usually the refund comes within three months after the review of the tax return.
